prompt_text: I am planning a trip. Should I book on Airbnb, Vrbo, or Booking.com, and how do I find a good host?
ai_overview_text:
Airbnb: Best for unique private rooms, urban apartments, local neighborhood experiences, and longer-term monthly stays. It offers a massive selection of independent and creative properties, though cleaning fees and service charges can add up.
Vrbo: Best for entire homes, cabins, beach houses, and large families or groups traveling together. Vrbo does not offer shared spaces or private rooms in someone's occupied home; it focuses strictly on whole-property rentals.
Booking.com: Best for traditional hotels, resorts, guesthouses, and apartments managed by professional property managers. It features a massive hotel inventory alongside vacation rentals, often with flexible "book now, pay later" policies and loyalty discounts via Genius.
Comparison of Platforms
FeatureAirbnbVrboBooking.comPrimary Property TypesApartments, homes, private rooms, unique staysWhole houses, cabins, villas, condosHotels, apartments, villas, guesthouses, resortsShared Spaces / RoomsYes (private rooms available)No (entire places only)Rare (mostly independent rooms/properties)Cancellation PoliciesVaries by host (flexible to strict)Varies by host/ownerFrequently free cancellation on most roomsFee StructureService fees, cleaning fees set by hostsService fees, property feesVaries; many listings show total price upfront
Read Recent Reviews: Look past the overall star rating and read the last 5 to 10 written reviews. Pay attention to how the host responds to criticism or handles maintenance issues.
Check Host Status: On Airbnb, look for Superhosts who have a proven track record of high ratings, low cancellation rates, and fast response times. On Vrbo, look for Premier Hosts with strong reliability scores.
Test Communication: Send a quick question to the host before booking (e.g., about parking or check-in flexibility). A great host replies clearly and promptly within a few hours.
Inspect House Rules and Fees: Clear, transparent house rules and explicit cancellation policies signal an experienced, professional host. Avoid listings with vague descriptions or hidden expectations.
If you tell me where you are traveling, who you are traveling with, and your budget, I can recommend which platform fits your trip best.
